text:
Priya: FYI customer asked for a single chat turn to fan out to multiple integration calls (payments, pricing, inventory), with independent timeouts and the ability to stream partial results back to the client. They also want to cap retries across the entire fanout.
Dmitri: high level: we should expose an explicit fanout api shape instead of overloading function calls. Something like `fanout_mode`, `max_in_flight`, `per_call` config, and a `global_retry_budget`.
Carlos: example shape suggestion:
```json
{
  \"fanout_mode\": \"bounded_parallel\", // bounded_parallel | ordered_stream | sequential
  \"max_in_flight\": 4,
  \"calls\": [
    { \"name\": \"get_price\", \"timeout_ms\": 400, \"retries\": 1, \"idempotent\": true },
    { \"name\": \"charge_card\", \"timeout_ms\": 1200, \"retries\": 0, \"idempotent\": false }
  ],
  \"global_retry_budget\": 2,
  \"emit_partial\": true
}
```
Maya: operational notes: if a non-idempotent call gets retried we need explicit consent from the caller (idempotency token). We should emit a warning in the response metadata when retry was attempted for a non-idempotent call.
Priya: customer expectation: they want "results-as-available" streaming by default for bounded_parallel, but when they pick ordered_stream they expect the runtime to buffer and emit results in their requested order even if slower.
Dmitri: from infra POV, bounded_parallel with emit_partial increases concurrency pressure and egress spikes. Need quota multiplier applied per-turn (eg. multiplier = number_of_calls). Also should tie max_in_flight to account tier.
Carlos: RPC/SDK contract: we should return a per-call status blob with fields: `call_name`, `status`, `attempts`, `latency_ms`, `bytes`, `cost_units`, and `ordering_key` if provided by caller. This enables billing and troubleshooting.
Maya: observability: require trace_id correlation across all fanout children and provide per-child span ids for OpenTelemetry. Also surface a per-turn summary: total_calls, successful, failed, retries_consumed, aggregate_cost.
Priya: MVP proposal (narrow): implement bounded_parallel with max_in_flight default 3, per-call timeout and retries, global_retry_budget, emit_partial true. No transactional or compensating actions. No ordered_stream in MVP.
Dmitri: agree. add non-goals: saga semantics, automatic compensation, distributed two-phase commit.
Carlos: doc checklist for launch: API reference, sample JS streaming snippet, Python sync example, SDK helper to synthesize idempotency tokens, and a troubleshooting FAQ.
Priya: rollout plan: 1) RFC + API spec (Dmitri/Carlos) 2) perf tests and cost model (Maya) 3) security review for outbound call surface (security team) 4) partner POC (customer team). Target: internal alpha in 6 weeks, external beta Q3.
Maya: acceptance criteria: unit tests for ordering/emission, perf under 4x call multiplier at p95, telemetry shows per-call attribution, and customer POC validated with sample workload.
Dmitri: edge case: what if one call blocks on human approval? We need a backpressure hint: `block_on` or `dont_block` flag per call. By default dont_block and respect timeout.
Carlos: add small JS streaming example to RFC:
```js
// pseudocode
const res = await client.chat.fanout({ fanout_mode: 'bounded_parallel', max_in_flight: 3, calls: [...] })
for await (const chunk of res.stream()) {
  // chunk: { call_name, status, payload, meta }
}
```
Priya: security: require optional allowlist for outbound hosts in private deployments, and log full call metadata only with PII-scrubbing enabled.
Maya: infra action: simulate a scenario with 1000 simultaneous turns each with 4 calls to validate autoscaling + quota behavior. I'll own that.
ops-bot: Created task INF-2401 "fanout chat-turn API RFC" assigned to Dmitri, Maya, Carlos.
Priya: good progress. We'll reconvene after RFC draft.
